title: Add an in-tool agent onboarding/capabilities contract
recommendation: Add `rpce-headless capabilities --json` and `rpce-headless robot-docs guide` or an equivalent MCP `headless_capabilities` tool. Include loaded-root semantics, stdio vs restricted/full socket tool exposure, recommended onboarding sequence, context_builder lifecycle, agent_manage/list_agents then agent_run pattern, oracle opt-in guidance, fake-agent fixture caveat, exit codes, and smoke commands.

title: Make help first-try friendly and exit 0
recommendation: Teach top-level and subcommands to accept `--help`/`-h` and exit 0. Bare `rpce-headless` should either exit 0 with concise help or offer the exact command to run. Include `serve --help`, `dump --help`, `connect --help`, and `context-build --help` tests.

title: Document and encode the preferred read-only subagent pattern
recommendation: Make the recommended main-agent flow explicit in docs and in-tool robot docs: verify root, call `agent_manage list_agents`, choose an available real/low-cost agent, start bounded read-only `agent_run` tasks for docs/source/tests, poll/wait, get logs, cleanup sessions, integrate with direct file evidence. The flow should bless context_builder and read-only agent_run as default-positive, while keeping oracle opt-in.

title: Teach fallback when code structure is unavailable
recommendation: When `get_code_structure` has no codemap for a path/language, return a useful hint that names `file_search` and `read_file` fallback commands. Consider adding common TS/Python codemap support later, but the immediate ergonomic fix is an error/result that teaches the next move.

recommendation: Either split one-shot and async lifecycle into clearer tool surfaces, or enrich the existing schema descriptions with concrete examples for synchronous clarify, async start/wait/get_result, timeout vs timeout_seconds, cleanup, and unsupported export_response.
